The first release of the new Codex Study Studio repository preserves the current bilingual skills, source-linked study hub, teaching slides, full narrated lesson and AI agent learning example.

- Project-owned material uses PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Commercial use outside its permissions requires prior written authorisation from Moonaria123.
- Redistribution of Study Studio-owned material covered by the project's PolyForm licence must include the licence text or URL and retain every supplied `Required Notice:` line identifying the original author. Separately licensed third-party material retains its own terms and notices.
- Both skill archives include `LICENSE`, `LICENSING.md` and `NOTICE.md`. The sample archive includes the project licence and author notice alongside Microsoft's separate MIT notice.
- The learning runtime, course data and media are unchanged from the previous repository's current content. This v1.0.0 starts a new release sequence; previously granted MIT rights remain in force.
- Package integrity, installation safeguards, five node-detail tests and JavaScript syntax checks passed. SHA-256 checksums are included below.

[Live study hub](https://moonaria123.github.io/Codex-Study-Studio/demo/StudyHub.html) · [Full sample lesson](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aLF_IylZ3y8) · [Licensing](https://github.com/Moonaria123/Codex-Study-Studio/blob/main/LICENSING.md)
